title: Weekly Indivisible Standout on I-91 Overpass on Bark Haul Road, Longmeadow
description:
On Wednesday afternoons from 3:45 pm to 5:30 pm bring your signs of peaceful protest highlighting the negative aspect of the Trump agenda most concerns you.  We'll display them so that the drivers on I-91 heading north and/or south can see AND READ them.  Remember that BIG SIGNS are easier to read at highway speeds.   

You need not stay for the entire time period.  

All are welcome.  

Come when you can and leave when you want.  

This is your chance to directly tell your fellow citizens what you think think about the negative policies and actions of the Trump administration.

Directions to the Bark Haul Road overpass that is just off Route 5 (Longmeadow Street) in Longmeadow, MA can be found on Google Maps or any other directions app.   The overpass is very near the intersection of Bark Haul Road and Pondside Road in Longmeadow.   

There's plenty of parking, although you can't park on the overpass.

We look forward to you joining us!

title: Tesla Takedown Tuesday: Montlake Overpass!
description:
**Join us for Tesla Takedown Tuesday and help send a clear message to Musk and Trump: We're not backing down.**

Our protests have helped force Musk from DC but our work is far from done. **Tesla's stock is UP because investors think we're going to fade away** while Musk buys our elections, spews hate and lies on his social network, and bullies even conservative members of Congress into giving Trump the power of a KING.

Join us on the pedestrian bridge over Montlake Blvd between the Burke Gilman Trail and the UW Montlake Parking Lot (E01).

It's the Northernmost (closest to UVillage) pedestrian bridge over Montlake Blvd. The bridge connects the Burke Gilman Trail and the huge parking lot north of Hec Ed. We have American flags hanging from the bridge (usually in distress configuration) in both directions. 

**Every day brings a new crisis of corruption, chaos, or cruelty. Share your thoughts on the damage Musk and Trump are inflicting:**

- attacks on due process and immigrants
- abdication of checks and balances by Congress and the Courts
- theft of our data by Musk and DOGE
- corruption by the President

Bring your own sign or borrow one of ours, we always have extras!

See you Tuesday! 

— Robin

PS. For our full schedule of protests, check out DefundMusk.com.
PPS. We're also at the overpass on other weekdays at the same time.

Tesla Takedown is a peaceful protest movement. We oppose violence, vandalism and destruction of property. Please treat Tesla drivers with respect as they are most likely on our side!

#TeslaTakedown #BoycottTesla #DefundMusk

title: Visibility CLT Pop-up Protest - Independence Hwy Overpass
description:
Join a pop-up protest with Visibility CLT/ICLT this week -- and bring a friend!

Good Reminders: Indivisible CLT/Visibility CLT is committed to peaceful, non-violent protesting. We do not engage with those that have opposing views, and we work to de-escalate as situations arise.

title: Defend Democracy Rally
description:
Join the Mazomanie rally, where WE THE PEOPLE will stand for democracy and show a unified voice against this administration's unconstitutional actions.

Gather with our community every Thursday from 4-5 pm on Hwy 14 near 510 Scott St. Bring signs that let others know what matters to you. Some signs are available for use.

There’s no such thing as bad weather, just bad clothing choices. Dress for success!

title: Weekly Darrell Issa Office Rallies!
description:
Join us every Friday from 9:00 at Darrell Issa’s Escondido office. We’ll meet first at the office and then walk as a group to the public sidewalk on Lincoln Blvd. Bring your protest signs and a folding chair if you can’t stand for an hour or so. Consider a double-sided sign so that you can have one message for Issa and another for the motorists.

We will have a food drive benefiting Interfaith Community Services in Escondido the last Friday of every month. Please bring non-perishable, new food items. https://interfaithservices.org/

Rallies are a great way to meet other like-minded community members. They remind us that we aren’t alone and it feels good to be civically engaged. Action is the antidote to despair. We guarantee you will feel better about the state of affairs when you leave this event.

Please note that there is a mental health services business in Issa’s office. Please allow a direct path the elevator for patients at all times. Refrain from banging on the glass doors as it has been reported to upset some of the patients. Please follow all posted rules and traffic laws when attending a rally. Safety is always our first priority. Safety patrol volunteers will be wearing bright vests - please comply with their requests at all times.

description:
# Let's Make Our Voices Heard!

**Indivisible Douglas County** invites you to join us every Saturday this summer in solidarity and protest against the Trump administration. We are coming together on a weekly basis to show Douglas County, the state of Oregon, the country, and the world that we will not will not stand for tyranny. 

**Join us!** Bring your creative protest signs, your voice, your spirit, and your family and friends along with you. Let's show our community that we are not okay with what is happening in this country, and we have something to say about it! Be vocal, have fun, and keep it peaceful.

Our plan is to protest along the sidewalks of Garden Valley Blvd in Roseburg from in front of the BLM building's green space, in both directions. 

This a local Indivisible event!

*A core principle behind all Indivisible events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.*

Please be advised that weekly Saturday protests may not have a Safety Team present at every event. Contact law enforcement if your physical safety feels threatened.”

title: Avelo Airline Nationwide Protest
description:
**Indivisible Mesa is joining the Coalition to Stop Avelo's nationwide call to action for a full boycott of Avelo Airlines and organizing protests at all 54 airports where they operate.** Our goal? Drive ticket sales to ZERO and make Avelo feel the consequences of profiting from deportations.

On May 31st, Indivisible Mesa was part of the **26 protests across the country** who came together to protest Avelo Airlines on the same day for the first time! To keep the pressure on Avelo, the Coalition is planning to support additional nationwide protests and Indivisible Mesa is again joining the call!!

**Indivisible Mesa will be protesting against Avelo Airlines operating ICE deportations on Saturday, August 23rd!** 

By protesting together, everywhere, on the same day, we elevate our anti-Avelo movement from a local news story to a can't miss national news story!

🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨

The message to **Avelo** is simple: **"Cancel your contract with ICE."**

The message to **City Hall** is simple: **"Stop funding Avelo with local dollars."**

The message to **travelers** is simple: **"Boycott Avelo, don't give them your money."**

The message to **allies** is simple: **"Join us. Stand for justice. Fight inhumanity."**

And the message to the **world** is powerful: 
*We stand for families. 
We stand for immigration rights. 
We stand for due process. 
We stand for all Americans who are feeling scared and vulnerable. 
We stand against companies that sacrifice people for profit. 
We stand against blood money and we stand against deals-with-the-devil. We stand against Avelo's contract with ICE. 
And we stand together, together, together. 
We will win this fight! 
We will force Avelo to cancel its ICE contract.**

Protest locally, speak nationally.

✨Be safe, be lawful, be loud. Bring signs. Bring friends. Take pics.✨


==**Protest Information**==

🌄 Indivisible Mesa will be at the intersection of East Ray Rd and Power Rd.

🅿️ There is PLENTY of parking in the store surrounding the intersection, including Walmart, Target, etc. 

❄️Bring all the things to keep yourself cool like cooling towels, umbrellas for shade, water, etc. and feel free to bring extra for other protestors if you are able to!

🔥Indivisible Mesa leadership realizes it may be too hot for some to attend the event, but we have to be outside and as visible as possible. IT'S VITAL. **If this means you can only protest for 20 mins, then please come for 20 mins!! Everybody and every minute counts!!**


==**Signs & Graphics**==
Please create signs and graphics that are relevant to Avelo & Mesa Gateway Airport! The messaging we put on our signs can do a lot to cut right through Mesa Gateway's bureaucratic smokescreen. 

   ☑️ Call attention to Avelo Airlines separating families

   ☑️ Complicity of Mesa/Gateway airport

   ☑️ Illegal deportations without due process

   ☑️ Human trafficking

   ☑️ Rather overheat than let human trafficking continue

   ☑️ Print out large pics of ICE kidnapping people in Phoenix

Please share and bring friends to protest against these flights that are illegal, inhumane, & unconstitutional.

title: Saturday Protests in O’Fallon, IL
description:
In solidarity with communities around us and in conjunction with local, grassroots Indivisible groups, join us for Saturday Morning Protests!

Every Saturday from 9-10:30am, we’ll gather in front of City Hall in O’Fallon, IL, for a peaceful protest to let our government officials and community know that we stand against the awful actions of the current administration.

Whether you care about cuts to Medicare, attacks on science, or the cruelty of our current immigration system—choose an issue, make a sign (just cardboard and marker is fine), and meet us in O’Fallon on Saturdays!

Why protest? 
(1) Protests are effective - We saw their effectiveness in Serbia in 2000, Ukraine in 2014, S. Korea in 2024, etc. 
(2) Protests change the narrative, bring-in new people, foster community, and spread courage. 
(3) Protests cause MAGA loyalists to defect and refuse to comply. 
(4) Protests make repression backfire. 
(5) Protests involve mass participation that brings Power, and that Power enables larger actions such as boycotts, mass non-cooperation like a General Strike, etc.

title: Honk & Wave: Tell Avelo Airlines to Cancel ICE Agreement

address_lines: near the intersection of Rt. 13 and School Lane

description:
Co-hosted by 302 United and Indivisible Highlands and Beyond.

Avelo Airlines has accepted a $150 million contract to operate deportation flights, aiding and colluding with the federal government in the illegal removal of individuals without their right to a fair hearing or due process. 

We demand that Avelo Airlines cancels their agreement with ICE immediately. Come out and help us keep up the pressure on AVELO and to promote a boycott until they change course.

Bring signs! We will have some to share, but we urge you to continue making your own great/creative signs! (Given often fast-moving traffic, a reminder about signs: 
Keep the message simple;
use large letters;
and make the letters thick and bold.)

We'll rally on both sides of Rt. 13, so stay on whichever side of the highway you park on. Please do NOT cross the busy highway!

After the Honk & Wave, all are welcome to gather at the IHOP across the street for "Protest and Pancakes!" (You don't have to get pancakes; they have avocado toast and veggie sausage, too!) Join us to connect and converse!!

Parking Options:

Go to Lot D, $7.00 per car, then walk to the nearby sidewalk along the DuPont Hwy. (The first section of Lot D is a quick right turn after passing the ChristianaCare-GoHealth Urgent Care, right next to the Wilmington Airport.The second section of Lot D is a right turn immediately after you past this first turn for lot D.  There is a sign for Lot D at this turn.)

You can create an account online ahead of time so you can complete your payment from home in advance.  We recommend taking this step ahead of time, so you can just park and join us. Go to this link to set up your parking account: https://p-123.com/. Click on the ‘create your account now’ button. You will be asked for the zone ID which is 10500. You will add your license plate number, then pay with a credit card. 
You could also use this same link or a QR code once you arrive to pay.  The signs in the parking lot have this info.
At this link below you can see where Lot D (or Remote lot) is located:
https://www.flyilg.com/parking-wilmington-airport-ilg

Parking is also available behind the IHOP across the street: specifically, try the large shopping area lot between IHOP and Planet Fitness. (Again, if you park there, stay on that side of the road to rally along DuPont Hwy in front of the IHOP. Do NOT cross DuPont Hwy.)

title: A Funeral for the Constitution - A Peaceful Protest of the Inaction of Senator Thom Tillis
description:
Join us on August 23, we will gather in downtown Greensboro dressed in black, not in celebration - but in mourning.
This solemn protest, led by concerned citizens across North Carolina, is a funeral march for our Constitution - the foundational document Senator Thom Tillis continues to undermine and nullify, piece by piece.
As we carry a symbolic coffin through the streets, accompanied by the haunting sound of a lone bagpipe, we will grieve the erosion of civil liberties, voting rights, and democratic norms. This is not a spectacle. This is a eulogy - for fairness, for accountability, and for a government of the people.

With peaceful resolve and powerful symbolism, we will honor what has been lost and demand better from those elected to serve us. We mourn, we march, and we resist - because democracy should not die in silence.

This is an event by the Accountability Coalition of the Triad (ACT) in conjunction with Indivisible Guilford County.

title: #TeslaTakedown Santa Monica
description:
Elon Musk is using his fraudulent Tesla billions to destroy American society. We gather weekly to seek accountability from Musk, argue for his immediate dismissal from Tesla, and highlight the damaging real-world consequences of his political funding, which, despite Musk’s recent tantrums, include Trump’s Big Beautiful Bill and the pain and suffering it will bring.

⚡Sell your Teslas, dump your stock, join the picket lines.

⚡ We're tanking Tesla's stock price to stop Musk.

⚡Stopping Musk will help save lives and protect our democracy.

The stakes couldn’t be higher. No one is coming to save us. Not politicians, not the media, not the courts.

Tesla Showroom: 300 Broadway (intersection of Third & Broadway)

Tesla Takedown is a peaceful protest movement. We oppose violence, vandalism and destruction of property. This protest is a lawful exercise of our First Amendment right to peaceful assembly.

PRO TIPS:

☮️ Please do not engage hecklers or single out individual drivers in a threatening way. Winning hearts and minds is the only way we will accomplish our goals. Aggression will be eagerly documented by our foes and used to discredit our message.

☮️ We support everyone’s right to free speech. However, the national #TeslaTakedown movement recently issued guidance to please reduce usage of “swastika” symbols on signs. Elon Musk has, of course, earned his popular association with such ugly symbols, but we risk being misconstrued or offending potential allies by having them all over our signs. Again, winning as many hearts and minds as possible is our aim.

☮️ Bring shade and water if it’s a sunny day. It can get pretty hot out there, especially if you’re dancing and singing with us :)

#TeslaTakedown #BoycottTesla #BoycottMusk

title: NO NUKES VIGIL - Every Friday
description: The Santa Fe chapter of Veterans For Peace started this vigil in 2002 and have continued it every Friday at noon for 23 years. Its purpose is to bring awareness to the hundreds of billions of our tax dollars going to the production of new nuclear weapons here in our state. Many people, even many New Mexicans, are unaware that Los Alamos National Lab is currently building several new bomb factories to increase production of nuclear bomb cores (known as plutonium "pits") to reach a goal of 30 to 120 new pits per year. Each pit, on average, has the destructive power of 20 Hiroshima-sized bombs. title: Weekly (Tues) I-91 Overpass Standout - Mtn Park Rd, Holyoke, MA
description:
Bring a friend!!!

Come out to show that ordinary people can raise their voices against the chaos and destruction of this Administration. Help remind folks that they, too, can stand up for their beliefs - and that there's lots and lots of people who aren't on board with the "cruelty as entertainment" behavior of Trump and Musk and the GOP.

### Recent DOT Visits

A Department of Transportation employee visited twice in the three weeks prior to 5/20 to ask that people NOT attach anything to the fencing. On 5/20, he parked and waited until everything was removed from the fencing. It seems reasonable to expect that DOT enforcement will continue. We haven't seen him lately, but...

### How to Get There

The address "9 Mountain Park Rd, Holyoke" will get you there if you're using Waze. (Mountain Park Road runs off Route 5, and is not accessible from I-91.) People have reported that some GPS systems bring you right under the bridge, but on I-91. That’s annoying!

Please park on the side of the road before the bridge. We can't park on the bridge.

### Other Stuff

Please take everything you brought away with you, and leave the site totally clean.

If rain is predicted, we'll cancel. If we cancel, you'll receive an email notification.

We may see a counter protester. If so, the best thing to do is just ignore them and spend our time and energy waving to motorists. Let's keep things 100% non-confrontational in words and body language.

### A Few Requests

We've found that roof rake sections make wonderful flagpoles and banner poles. If you have a roof rake (or 10’-15’ light metal poles or conduit) to contribute, we'll be happy to take it off your hands!

Donations...we've purchased banners and grommets and flags and zip ties and bungee cords, and we'll be getting more. We’ve purchased 20” x 30” letter boards for messaging we can change. All this costs $$$. We'll have a bucket for donations, and if you could throw something in, that'd be great. And if not, that's perfectly OK, too - your presence is what's really important. See where the money's going! https://tinyurl.com/IN-SLWMProtestTeamFinancials

title: Good Trouble Fridays - Weekly Protest

address_lines: San Pablo Dam Road & Appian Way

description:
This a local Indivisible West CoCo County event!

 "Speak up, speak out, get in the way. Get in good trouble, necessary trouble, and help redeem the soul of America.” That was the message from the legendary John Lewis to all of us who fight for justice and freedom. It is that message that we carry with us as we face the greatest threat to our freedom and democracy since the Civil War. 

Join us every Friday, 5pm – 6pm at the corner of San Pablo Dam Road and Appian Way. We bring the hope and commitment carried by John Lewis throughout his life to the streets of our West County community. 

FOOD, TOWEL & TOILETRIES DRIVE: If you can, bring a can or box of food for our community (no glass) &/or shower amenities for the unhoused in our local community.

Bring signs, peaceful energy, friends, flags, chants, etc.

"Do not get lost in a sea of despair. Be hopeful, be optimistic. Our struggle is not the struggle of a day, a week, a month, or a year, it is the struggle of a lifetime. Never, ever be afraid to make some noise and get in good trouble, necessary trouble," Congressman John Lewis.

title: Rally in Mentor to say NO to Cuts, Raids, and War--Congressman Joyce--HELP!!
description:
Come and join members of Ohio District 14 as we stand together to protest the harmful actions of the Trump Administration.     We gather every Friday from 10-11:30 along Mentor Avenue in Eleanor Garfield Park to say that we do not approve of Donald Trump's plan to cut funding for vital programs like Medicaid and Snap.  We do not approve of Donald Trump's plan to tear families apart by forcibly removing non-dangerous immigrants in our communities.   And we do not approve of Donald Trump (who called himself the "Peace President") bombing Iran without the approval of Congress and the people of the United States.   

We have reached out to Congressman Dave Joyce with our concerns about the harm of the Trump Administration, but we have not heard back with specific and reassuring responses.  And we have questions for the Congressman.  We want to know why Congressman Joyce voted to cut Medicaid and Snap.   We want to know why Congressman Joyce is allowing the Trump administration to terrify immigrants in our communities.  We want to know why Congressman Joyce did not take a stand against bombing Iran--an aggressive move that could be the start of the United States going to war in the Middle East.   All of these actions will cause harm to Congressman Joyce's constituents.  

***Congressman Joyce, we want you to stand up for the health, wellbeing, and safety of your constituents.  Please come and join us.  We need your help saying "NO" to the harmful behavior of the Trump administration. ***

Attendees:
Please bring friends and family and family-friendly signs.  Children have been joining us now that school is out.

Feel free to bring a chair, and join for any amount of time you are able.    Please park in the lower lot and walk up the hill to our protest site if you are able.   Leave the upper lot open for elders and families with young children.  Please do not park on the grass as vendors need to set up in this area for the Mentor Farmers Market.   

If you are able, please bring non-expired food and personal care items to donate to our local food pantries.   Food items include canned proteins, peanut butter and jelly, canned fruits and vegetable, and shelf stable food items such as grains, pasta, and cereal.  Personal care items include hand soap, toilet paper, tissues, paper towels, tampons, and diapers.


*A core principle behind all events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants not to engage with drivers, passers-by, and counter protestors who have different ideas than ours and show this in an unkind manner.  We will not return the hurt and anger.  We have an opportunity to show kindness and bridge the divide.  Let's take this opportunity.  Our nation needs this.*

This event is hosted by Ohio District 14 Partners--A coalition of pro-democracy groups in Ohio District 14.    June 27th marked our 20th event.

***Note--This event used to be held in front of the building that houses Congressman Joyce's office--8500 Station St., The Matchworks Building.   We used to enter the building in small groups to talk with the staff members in the Congressman's office while others protested on the sidewalk in front of the building.  Our group grew from 3 people to 60 people in 8 weeks.    We were not permitted to park in the lot in large numbers, so we decided to move to Eleanor Garfield Park.   

Individuals are permitted to park and enter the Matchworks Building to talk to staff members in the Congressman's Office on the third floor on M-F from 9-5.   We strongly encourage you to do this.  This action is a great way to protect and improve democracy.

title: Transit, NOT Tolls — Trains, NOT Interstates

location.venue: District One Florida Department of Transportation Headquarters

description:
# Polk County Wants TRANSIT — NOT TOLLS,  TRAINS — NOT INTERSTATES!
### Bartow, FL
#### W Van Fleet and N Broadway Ave
**11 am - 1 pm**
**Hosted by [Defund Oligarchy Blessed by Liberty](https://www.blessedbyliberty.org/)**

FDOT and the Polk County BOCC are planning an interstate extension that would cut through Lake Wales, Davenport, and other parts of eastern Polk County, in an effort to promote future development. 

But all proposed routes threaten critical areas: Bok Tower, family farms, or the habitat of the Blushing Scrub Balm—a rare native plant found nowhere else on Earth. Despite the rapid pace of new development, rents remain high and affordable housing is scarce. We are facing record-high foreclosure rates and thousands of vacant homes. 

So who is this development really for? Certainly not the people of Polk County. What will this mean for our already strained water supply? 

We must act now—protect Polk County! Protect the Blushing Scrub Balm. Polk County is not for sale. Let's stand up for public transit, and say NO WAY to the interstate. 

There is another option that FDOT refuses to consider: the NO-BUILD alternative. Join us for a sign-waving event on the public sidewalk. We are raising awareness and building up to a larger protest later this year. Let your voice be heard.

### Location & Instructions 
- Meet on the sidewalk at the intersection of Van Fleet & Broadway.
- FDOT office is 801 N Broadway Ave. 
- Bring signs & Florida state flags.
- Come early or come late. You don't have to stay the whole time. Come to wave a sign or come to learn more. We will have resources for letter writing available. 
- This will be a reoccurring assembly to raise awareness in the months leading up to FDOT's meeting at the end of this year. Our goal is to inform commuters and get this issue on people's radar. As well as to deliver letters and provide further resources on how to follow-up with FDOT and County Commissioners.

**Dress code:** Floridian! whatever you normally wear swimming, hunting, or fishing

*A core principle behind all Indivisible events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.*

title: Tesla Takedown Tuesday: Woodland Park Overpass!
description:
**Join us for Tesla Takedown Tuesday and help send a clear message to Musk and Trump: We're not backing down.** We're going to defeat Trump and the billionaires who put this felon in the White House. 

Our protests have helped force Musk from DC but our work is far from done. **Tesla's stock is UP because investors think we're going to fade away.** That's not going to happen. 

Join us at HWY 99's North Woodland Park pedestrian overpass.

**Every day brings a new crisis of corruption, chaos, or cruelty. Share your thoughts on the damage Musk and Trump are inflicting:**

- attacks on due process and immigrants
- abdication of checks and balances by Congress and the Courts
- theft of our data by Musk and DOGE
- corruption by the President!

Bring your banners or help crew our two banners and one Pikachu. 

[Parking is super convenient](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uyyEW15sor9Rxr816)

See you Tuesday! 

— Dan

PS. For our full schedule of protests, check out DefundMusk.com.


Tesla Takedown is a peaceful protest movement. We oppose violence, vandalism and destruction of property. Please treat Tesla drivers with respect as they are most likely on our side!

title: STAND UP FOR DEMOCRACY! Marblehead (Every Saturday 5-6 p.m.)
description:
Stand with us on the sidewalks at the corner of Maple Street and Lafayette Street (Route 114) in Marblehead from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m. every Saturday for a nonpartisan, peaceful stand-out to stand up in defense of American democracy.

America is in a Constitutional crisis.

America stands for laws and due process, science, free speech, equality, and respect for all people.  Stand together to strengthen our community and our collective voice.

Come to this peaceful demonstration. Bring your signs, your friends, your determination—and your belief that the United States was never meant to have kings. Join us!


Organized by the Marblehead Alliance for Democracy

title: Copy of: Mondays @ McCormick's
description:
This is an EMERGENCY! Senate Protest Event in Philadelphia Continues This Week and For the Foreseeable Future.

Now called "Mondays at McCormick's" each Monday at noon - rain or shine - Here's why:

We are living in a MAGA-republican Coup. We were warned. Now it's here!

Here at home our democratic rights are being eroded and the Trump/Musk team is putting us all in danger. The limits of Executive power against the courts are being tested every day. If Trump decides to ignore the courts, there is very little they can do to enforce their decisions and unless Congress acts, it would be a true constitutional crisis. (And so far, Congress is controlled by the MAGA movement and the Democrats have not done enough to stand up and fight back.) It could even spiral down into outright civil war as competing factions and states careen between untested solutions to protect their own interests and those of their constituents and funders. There is real harm being done across the entire domestic sector. Layoffs, program cuts for the needy and for the average US resident, persecution of law abiding immigrants and students and other activists for simply speaking their mind and organizing constitutionally protected protest. Fear is also their weapon.

Our international role is being flipped on its head - yes, the US has always had a questionable foreign policy, providing aid and promoting democracy and human rights - to a degree - on the one hand, while at the same time invading other countries for the good of corporate profits and geopolitical dominance. Trump considers a policy to outright invade counties like Mexico and Greenland in violation of international law and to extend US power - A clear expression of Empire! Trump is considering power grabs not unlike those that the Nazi regime in Germany perpetrated in search of "Lebensraum", (Living Space) a euphemism for territorial conquest. And they got away with it (for a while) because the people who stood up were either jailed, exiled or murdered. The rest were either regime supporters (Like the solid 30% base of the MAGA movement) or went along out of fear of retribution. We cannot let fear prevent us from standing up this time. History will judge us.

We now have a true oligarchy in the US and we must fight back!

The Trump administration’s illegal actions and relentless efforts to dismantle protections for vulnerable communities — both here in the U.S. and abroad— have made clear we are in the midst of an authoritarian takeover not unlike what has happened in Orban’s Hungary. 

His plan to "Own Gaza" and move out Palestinians is NOT a plan to destroy Hamas and increase Israeli security - it is ETHNIC CLEANSING pure and simple. It's a land grab. All for development rights and to secure a seaport access to natural gas deposits off the shore of Gaza in the Mediterranean Sea. The Levant gas field includes the shores of historic Palestine (Israel and Gaza), Syria, Lebanon and, on the opposite side, the island of Cyprus. This field is estimated to contain about 122 trillion cubic feet of natural gas. So it will accelerate the climate emergency. 

As we all know Trump/Musk plan to get rid of a number of government agencies that protect our health, livelihood and constitutional rights. - the EPA is on the hit list. The Department of Education is too. So, is the CDC, the NIH and many other important agencies that protect the US public.

As we all know - thousands have already been fired, causing chaos and havoc and real harm to both dedicated civil servants AND people served by life affirming programs voted on by the U.S. people and enacted, in most cases, by the U.S. Congress. The Administration may have authority to make staffing decisions, but as is the case with the Department of Education - many of these agencies can only be eliminated by acts of Congress - Trump has overstepped his legal authority.

Thankfully, the courts have, so far, acted as a check on much of Trumps clear and blatant abuses of executive power. But we cannot count on the courts, particularly the US Supreme court, which has been stacked by Trump appointees and ideologues friendly to executive power. 

Resistance is NOT futile - it is essential. 

We are launching "Monday's at McCormick's" each Monday at noon - rain or shine - we will assemble peaceably - as is our constitutional right - outside Senator McCormick's Philadelphia office until Senator McCormick agrees to meet with us and support our demands: (These will change as conditions develop)

 1 - Stop voting for legislation inspired by Trump's project 2025 agenda - a plan to slash Medicaid, gut school lunch programs, and shut down nursing homes while handing more power to billionaires like Elon Musk. 

2- Roll back Trump's mean spirited and Unconstitutional funding pauses. Shutting down USAID is already killing people in need all over the World. Cuts to programs here in the US could do the same. Funding for these programs are up to the Congress and the US people to decide, not Trump! 

That's just for starters. Overall we want Senator McCormick to represent us all, not just his rich friends. We want Senator McCormick to DO HIS JOB!
The stakes could not be higher. The administration is pushing an authoritarian agenda that threatens our democracy, our rights, and the well-being of millions here at home and around the planet. 

We have the power to resist—and we must use every tool at our disposal to stop them.

title: ResistAustin - TeslaTakedown - Protest - St. Elmo
description:
**What are we doing?**:

- Protesting Tesla's link to right-wing populist authoritarians like Trump (https://www.cbsnews.com/news/elon-musk-277-million-trump-republican-candidates-donations/)
- Dissuading prospective Tesla customers from buying or leasing new Teslas
- Educating onlookers and passerbys about the damage that Elon Musk has done and is doing to our democracy and others

**Why are we doing it?**:

Watch this speech by a ResistAustin organizer that explains the overall reasoning for our Tesla protest campaign: https://youtu.be/uy1JZn_DYcA

**What should you expect?**

- A protest emcee or two
- A medium size group of people consisting of regulars, semiregulars, and newbies
- Supplies with which to exercise your 1A rights, such as markers and posters
- Water and possibly snacks
- A focal point, like the Tesla store, where you may verbally and visually direct your grievances
- Music
- Chanting
- (Uncertain) Counterprotestors
- Here's a video of the "vibe" though we can't promise another piñata! https://youtube.com/shorts/swClQdntgJ0

**What if counterprotestors arrive?**:

"Bullhorn Bully," the serial harasser a.k.a. Will Johnson, most recently visited our protest at Tesla North on 5/24/2025. On that day, he was accompanied by up to 6 members of the WTF biker club, who are documented having aggressively harassed an Austin elected official in 2020, and engaged in an act of attempted intimidation towards ResistAustin earlier this year.

Our guidance is to ignore and/or quietly document Mr. Johnson - he appears to get frustrated and lose focus when no one is engaging with him - he needs protestors to be provoked for his livestream to be entertaining to his audience.

Here are some results of documenting his actions:
https://youtube.com/shorts/CfdwxO-CVoo
https://youtube.com/shorts/nqxoHfibGsY
https://youtube.com/shorts/h_amC8QPm6M

To aid in our effort document counterprotestors like Mr. Johnson, please "extensively document" any suspicious, harassing, or menacing behavior via photo/video and send the recordings with a brief description of your observations to our email inbox, info@resistaustin.us

**What should you bring?**

(Basic)
- Water in a light thermos or water bottle
- Snack
- Sunscreen
- Hat and/or sunglasses
- Light backpack to carry all of the above

(Medium)
- Homemade sign w/ or w/o a handle

(Advanced)
- Bullhorn/megaphone

**Where should you park?**

Tesla St. Elmo is at 500 E. St. Elmo Rd as you turn into a restaurant and brewery center called The Yard. You can get to St. Elmo Rd from Congress/275 or the Frontage of I-35-S. You can also get to it from Ben White/71 East Frontage. It is in an industrial park with no street curbs. You might find limited parking along St. Elmo off the side of the road between Willow Springs and Lucksinger Lane. Otherwise, turn down Lucksinger Lane and head to Sheraton Ave. There is parking at Battle Bend Park or on neighborhood streets on Sheraton Ave or Rowland Drive. It is ½ a mile walk from Tesla and should take 12 to 15 minutes to walk there.

**Final Thoughts**

Unity and discipline are hallmark principles of successful nonviolent resistance movements and our movement will remain inviting and blameless if we maintain these principles in the face of provocation.

This is a peaceful protest. Remember the ABCs of protesting:

B) Beware of detractors*! Do not talk to detractors or unaffiliated interviewers - doing so increases risks for all of us, including all the volunteers and organizers.

C) Chill vibes please! Never touch anyone else or their property (e.g., car, sign, backpack) without permission. Have fun! Build community!

Some of their tactics are to act friendly, ask questions, and pretend to care about your answers. They may also gesture, yell, name-call, and use foul language. They often look to get a reaction they can capture on video. Do NOT engage with or speak to them. Do NOT answer their questions. Do NOT yell back at them or gesture (thumbs down, middle finger, etc.) Do NOT post photos or videos of them online. Do NOT reveal any personal or contact info to anyone at this or any rally you do not know to be on your side. If someone becomes threatening or violent, move away quickly and alert a safety volunteer, a police officer, and/or call 911. These guidelines keep you, our volunteers, and our organizers safe. Thank you!

**[Learn to de-escalate](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R2PSExM-NhU&list=PLqIrQkVlKU3RZw0ytVd3U7XS3ofAaZItu&index=2)**

My name is Syd and I call myself the reluctant activist, because I'd really rather be home resting, crocheting and managing my health issues but instead I'm forced to fight fascism in America. I'll be the one with the walker and the loud voice. 😁

With the rapid assaults on our rights, the government cuts designed to hurt the poor and vulnerable, along with endlessly funding genocide and much more,I feel it's important that we protest this insanity. 

I have a rally every Saturday. We meet from 12-1 on the sidewalk in front of the Neill Public Library. It's at the intersection of N Grand and Olson NE across from the Cougar Plaza.

This Big Beautiful Killer Bill is the opposite of what our government should do for the people. Republicans are choosing to let people go hungry, lose insurance and frankly, die. Not to balance the budget, they're doing it to reward the wealthiest.

We won't give up our rights to peacefully protest. We need to remind this administration that it's the people who have the power, it's supposed to be Congress that writes laws and declares war, that protest is legal but human trafficking is not.

I know these are scary times and I appreciate your bravery. I have rallied here multiple times and the most negative thing I have experienced is a few harsh words from a moving vehicle (that I usually can't hear). I simply reply with "I love you!" as loudly as I am able. It's fun and it prevents any hate from sticking to us. Mostly we get a lot of honking and waving. I find it invigorating, especially when we are surrounded by a lot of other rally-goers.

If someone does tries to instigate trouble don't confront them and remain peaceful. Come get me. You can also leave if you need to. Record video if you are able, so that authorities will be able to ID the agitator. It's important that our protest remain on the sidewalk and not block the traffic or crosswalks so we don't give the police a reason to arrest anyone.

I'm not downplaying the new steps towards full fascism this administration has taken and I don't want you to. Please take the necessary steps to protect yourself.

Again, I expect no problem at our little event, I expect colorful, creative signs, some chanting and numbers of like-minded people who care about our country. If you have any streamers or pinwheels to attach to your signs, please do.There's almost always a breeze. Get your feelings out on your signs, enjoy the marker fumes and chalk dust. Bring water. I bring a partially frozen water bottle on the hot days 

If you have any questions contact me here

p.s. Despite what Tr*mp and Fox News say, I have never received a paycheck for rallying against his theft of power, but I have noted his history of projection. Has he paid people to rally for him?

We participate and activate hyper-locally in this non-violent and peaceful social and cultural movement to protest authoritarianism in the U.S. and are building volunteer people power that is sustained, consistent, and unrelenting, until everyone is moved from their apathy and into action to stand up for democracy and re-dedicate themselves to building a better one. Only we, the people, can save us!

*A core principle behind all Indivisible events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.*

Follow us on...
BlueSky: @indivisiblenortheb.bsky.social
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61578209213440
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/indivisible_northeastbay 

and use #Indivisible!

title: Day of International Friendship -- Peace Arch, BC/WA -- Peace, Love, and a Handshake
description:
Come join us at Peace Arch Park on August 16th as PLH comes together with organizations across the US-Canada and US-Mexico borders, along with sites across the US, for a series of rallies called Friends Across Borders occurring on the same day, celebrating friendship and solidarity between the US, Canada, and Mexico. We want to show this administration that they may break our formal ties, but we will continue to cherish our personal relationships across borders. 
We will all be meeting at the Peace Arch!

Both Canadians and Americans can attend this event without needing to cross the border. Just make sure to follow the directions below to the corresponding parking lot for your country.

We have friends everywhere.

Flags and messages of FRIENDSHIP and SOLIDARITY are welcome. Meet at the monument!

We encourage all attendees who can to help contribute to the local economies of the border towns while visiting the rally.

Friends Across Borders Movement: https://www.friendsxborders.org/

Discover passes are required to park, although a day pass can be purchased for $10. We will meet at the monument. More info on the park here: https://parks.wa.gov/find-parks/state-parks/peace-arch-historical-state-park

-DIRECTIONS-

From the US:

Take exit 276 off I5 towards Blaine City Center. Once you’ve taken the exit, you’ll come to a roundabout. Take the second exit onto 2nd St. There’s a small street sign that says Peace Arch Park. Be sure not to take the third exit, as this will take you back onto the highway and right up to the border.

The entrance to the parking area is at the end of 2nd St. If you don’t have a Discovery Pass, there is $10 parking fee.

From Canada:

Take exit 1 off Highway 99 towards Beach Rd. Head west along Beach Rd. The Duty Free parking lot will be to your left. Continue past the parking lot. There’s a road that runs behind the Duty Free parking lot called Peace Arch Place. Turn left onto this road (you won’t be able to go any further on Beach Rd anyway as it’s closed). and continue until you get to the Peace Arch Park parking lot. Head to the south end of the parking lot. Walk south to the Peace Arch.

title: Community Strike by Immigrants

address_lines: PARK AT FLATIRON PARK ONLY PLEASE

description:
UPDATE: PLEASE PARK CAR AT FLAT IRON PARK FROM NOW ON. THEN WALK TO THE CORNERS. WE ARE NO LONGER ALLOWED TO PARK IN THE PLAZA ON THE CORNER. THANK YOU. 
Los Angeles announced August 12th they will protest for 24 hours against the raids on immigrants in their State of California. This is what an organizer had to say: 
Salas said the community is demanding an end to raids by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement that have been escalating in the Los Angeles area over the past month. She called the raids “a military operation — it is immoral, unlawful and it is purposely cruel.”

“Most importantly, what we are asking is a return of all of those people, all our loved ones, back home,” she said. “We want them back in L.A. We want them in their homes. That’s where they belong, and that’s what our fight is about. … And until those demands come, we will not stop organizing, we will not stop marching. And we call on Congress for accountability and oversight. We will file lawsuits and we will bring common sense to this deranged administration.”

We also have the same raids going on in our State of Arizona and we will stand with California and with all immigrants near and far!

"We have the power of our community and we are going to stop you with the power of the people" 
Written by Salas

title: Reproductive Freedom Friday

address_lines: South Pines Road & East Sprague Avenue

description:
Let's Rally for Reproductive Freedom!

From Pro Choice Washington: "About three years ago, the U.S. Supreme Court (SCOTUS) issued its decision in Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization, overturning nearly fifty years of constitutional protections for abortion access under Roe v. Wade.  

In doing so, the SCOTUS decision stripped millions of people of their reproductive freedom. And it opened the door to a sweeping wave of anti-abortion legislation, disinformation, criminalization, and political violence that’s currently playing out across our country. 

In the Dobbs decision, Justice Alito outlined his roadmap to dismantling our right to bodily autonomy and equal rights. Dobbs was just the beginning, as our community saw the continuation of erosion play out last week with the Skrmetti decision. https://prochoicewashington.org/2025/06/20/pro-choice-washington-skrmetti-case/

You have probably also seen the cuts to women's health to include cuts to Planned Parenthood.  I almost feel like this issue has been forgotten.  So... let's remind people!

One of our goals is to give love and support to people and organizations doing the right thing and being courageous.  We have few asks:

1.  Send a thank you card (or postcard) to one or all of the organizations below.  

We have been told by the providers that they SO VERY MUCH appreciate a thank you.  A little bit of gratitude goes a long way.  

Also, we are aware (as of 12/19/2024) that employees at the local Planned Parenthood are considering unionization over what they characterize as low pay and bad working conditions. Here is the full article from Range Media. https://rangemedia.co/planned-parenthood-washington-union/

We believe we can be supportive of patients and providers while also supporting everyone's right to fair pay, good working conditions and the right to unionize.  

Pro-Choice Washington
1916 Pike Place, Ste 12 #1449
Seattle WA 98101

Also, our own Sarah Dixit works for Pro-Choice Washington and is running for Spokane City Council. Here's her website https://www.sarahforspokane.com/ Please support her. We need more people like her in office who are committed to reproductive freedom.

Planned Parenthood Providers and Staff

Then we will have a Reproductive Freedom Rally from 4:30 - 5:30

Peaceful sidewalk rally. Bring signs.   American flags are always wonderful too. Please park carefully with consideration of businesses, etc.

Meet up afterwards 45 Degrees Brewhouse

RANGE is a media organization for people who love the Inland Northwest and want to make it better. title: Day of International Friendship DETROIT Hart Plaza
description:
The wave of arrests, kidnaps, social cuts, threats, environmental backward steps that we, as the American People, are witnessing and suffering from since January is deeply rooted in hatred. It is painful to watch. It is painful to live with. It is painful to think about the future where we know there is so much work to be done to repair the harm that is currently done to so many individuals and our country. We, because we are proud Americans  believing in the respect of the founding principles of our nation and because we are simply decent humans, will never let hate overtake love.

 We take a stand once again to hammer our values: we love our neighbors, from Canada and Mexico, we love those who come to our country to pick up vegetables in our farms, serve us food in restaurants, study in our universities, and care for our relatives in hospitals, we love the person living next door regardless of their skin color, gender, sexual orientation, because this is what we are fundamentally built to do. Helping and being helped, loving and being loved are the two pillars of human life. Take these out, not one of us would still be here. So, enough with hate. Come join We the People Dissent at Hart Plaza on August 16th for an international day of friendship! Dozens of locations are rallying at the same time across the US. You can check this website out to spot them all! And if you'd like to host one somewhere else in Michigan or in the country, you can do so! https://www.friendsxborders.org.

If you believe in friendship across nations, you will like the pledge we crafted: https://www.friendsxborders.org/sign Don't hesitate to read and sign it!

We will rally at 5 pm when the sun is down a bit to avoid the heat. But please remember to carry a water bottle. Use sunscreen. Last time, we saw lots of you bring an umbrella to create a bit of shade. Great idea! Bring on your umbrellas and signs of love!

There are no restrooms available at the Plaza itself. However buildings around can accommodate us. 

Laz parking garage is available on Bates street along the plaza and there are also two other parking garages off Griswold street that are conveniently located. 

We invite people of good will to join us for a peaceful, positive, and creative demonstration of friendship across borders.  We will affirm the values of peace, friendship, decency, and respect with our North American neighbors!!

title: Salmonberry Trail Guided Hike: Reehers
description:
Wander under a canopy of towering trees in the Tillamook State Forest, where old logging history meets lush rainforest. Keep an eye out for ferns, wildflowers, and the soothing sounds of nearby creeks.

**Getting to Reehers**
- Drive Highway 26 west (or east, depending on where you start) toward Timber Road (just past milepost 38).
- Turn left (south) onto Timber Road, follow for 3 miles into the rural community of Timber.
- Turn right (west) onto Cochran Road in Timber.
- Reehers Camp is 2.2 miles down Cochran Road, a well-maintained gravel road. Drive slowly and respectfully through Timber. 
- Park at the Reehers Camp Day Use Area -- on the left past the campground. Restrooms are available at the parking area, and there is no fee to park, but it is day-use only—no overnight parking or camping allowed.

title: Families Over Billionaires
description:
Join us early on Labor Day to honor all the workers of this country— including those working hard without benefit of citizenship— and support labor unions all across the USA! The billionaires of today—with encouragement and support of the current administration in DC— want to exploit workers, bust up unions and energetically, sometimes illegally or violently, discourage new unions from forming. title: Hands Along High Street

address_lines: Eight miles along High St. from Rt. 161 in Worthington south to downtown Columbus

description:
# We Stand United!

**THIS IS A MULTISTEP SIGN UP PROCESS!** Please read all the way to the end of this message. 

**NOTE** that the address given for this event (3923 N High St.) is a **PLACEHOLDER.** The event takes place along the entire 8-mile stretch of High Street between Rt. 161 in Worthington and downtown Columbus. 

Before you finish signing up here, please go to the [Hands Along High Street SignUp Genius page](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/9040F44AAAF2FA3F58-57596461-hands#/) to pick the exact location where you will be stationed during the protest (the Sign Up slot you pick has the actual address where you will meet). Then come back here and complete your registration.

**Read more about this unique event here:**

Join the final big resistance event of the summer before the beginning of the new school year! With your participation, we will form a **human chain of resistance** 8 miles long on the public sidewalk along the west side of High Street from Route 161 in Worthington to downtown Columbus, delivering the message that **WE STAND UNITED** for our common values as Americans:

We **OPPOSE** • The loss of health insurance and SNAP benefits for millions of Americans • Cuts to Medicaid, Medicare and Social Security •Tax cuts that overwhelmingly favor the rich and add trillions to the national debt.

We **DEFEND** • The rights of law-abiding immigrants •The victims of abuse • Science-based research and policies focused on climate change and public health  • **The democratic principles that have defined the United States for 249 years!**  

See our full [**Statement of Values**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cYe8rDXYJIsAqCQgyiRN0hqY1aVkqjIsH9jruXDwDV8/edit?tab=t.0) here.
 
This will be unlike any previous rally in Ohio, and signup is a bit different too. You can confirm your participation here, but to ensure that we have an unbroken chain, we also need to know where along the route you plan to be. So once you’ve finished here, please go to the [Hands Along High Street SignUp Genius page](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/9040F44AAAF2FA3F58-57596461-hands#/) and choose a location along the route. This will help our planning to make this event a success. 

**NOTE:** We will have a Moment of Unity where we link hands to form an 8-mile human chain. But leading up to that moment, we want the people of Columbus to know why we’re here. Please bring your protest signs, American flags, cowbells, etc. 

This is a family-friendly, peaceful event. Once you complete your registration, you will receive details about a day that we hope to remember for years to come!

The Baltimore-based empire of right-wing TV mogul David Smith [destroys the local Baltimore economy](https://therealnews.com/ethics-expert-sinclair-broadcasting-disclose-business-conflicts-baltimore), [discriminates against people of color](https://baltimorefishbowl.com/stories/whats-behind-the-dont-eat-atlas-beef/), and through its network of hundreds of local affiliates broadcasts [lies and misinformation](https://fair.org/home/how-sinclair-sneaks-right-wing-spin-into-millions-of-households/) that undermine our democracy! 

At our pop-up demonstrations, we call for the [boycott](https://www.mobilize.us/indivisiblebaltco/event/809227/) of all properties owned by the David Smith family business empire, including the following: 

* David Smith's Sinclair broadcasting group, which is the nation's second largest owner of local Fox affiliates. Sinclair includes over 290 local news stations across the country that collectively reach 40% of American households with right-wing [lies](https://fair.org/home/how-sinclair-sneaks-right-wing-spin-into-millions-of-households/) and [misinformation](https://www.npr.org/2018/04/02/598916366/sinclair-broadcast-group-forces-nearly-200-station-anchors-to-read-same-script). [WATCH this John Oliver segment](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GvtNyOzGogc) to learn more

* The Smith family's Atlas group of overpriced tourist restaurants that have been accused of back-room corruption, destroying the local restaurant scene, [gentrification](https://therealnews.com/ethics-expert-sinclair-broadcasting-disclose-business-conflicts-baltimore) and [racial discrimination](https://baltimorefishbowl.com/stories/whats-behind-the-dont-eat-atlas-beef/) 

* David Smith's Baltimore Sun, which has turned the city's once-proud paper of record into a mouthpiece for Smith's [culture war](https://www.npr.org/2024/02/26/1233856063/baltimore-sun-new-owner-david-smith-sinclair) and [right-wing propaganda](https://www.baltimorebrew.com/2025/07/01/baltimore-sun-fires-its-longtime-cartoonist-kevin-kal-kallaugher)

* David Smith's MileOne Autogroup, including 67 dealerships and 8 body shops in 5 states

At our pop-up demos, we say: Don't Feed the Fox! Save Local Baltimore! [Boycott](https://www.mobilize.us/indivisiblebaltco/event/809227/) the David Smith empire! Eat at these independent and Black-owned [restaurants](https://baltimore.org/what-to-do/african-american-owned-restaurants-in-baltimore/) instead!

Here are some ideas for [slogans](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1yiEtfmQAvWRDrUlgzkdPNSYqseH_AR2xRMTifIRJe2c/edit?usp=sharing)

**NOTE: Indivisible Baltimore County supports and exercises the constitutional right to peaceful assembly and free expression. We do not condone violence, property damage, or actions that interfere with public safety. Each individual is responsible for their own conduct. We will not heckle passersby or restaurant staff. We will not enter private businesses. We will remain on public sidewalks and ensure that pedestrians can pass safely at all times. Our goal is to uplift our message, not to cause harm to our community.**

description:

title: Good Trouble Lives On in Barton Vermont
description: Continuing the John Lewis: Good trouble, Barton and the neighboring communities will join together to voice our support for our Civil Rights.  We will be highlighting the importance of the Constitution and Bill of Rights. This rally will be our opportunity to demonstrate that we, along with a strong majority of Americans, support democracy and reject Trump’s anti-democracy agenda.  Aptly, we will continue to honor the legacy of John Lewis, who insisted that we overcome our hesitations, our fears, and our frustrations to stand up for our civil rights.  He did it at the Pettus Bridge in 1965, and we have the same ambitious goal–to reach the Americans who are ready to say, “Enough?  Not on our watch? We will not let democracy slip away!”

title: Solidarity September Labor Day Protest
description:
🔥 Solidarity September Labor Day Protest at the Capitol – Plus Post-Action Panel!
📍 Florida State Capitol, Tallahassee
🗓 Monday, September 1st
⏰ 9:00 – 10:30 AM
📣 Hosted by the Big Bend Labor Chapter, Environmental Caucus co-host
________________________________________

This Labor Day, we’re taking a stand at the Historic Florida Capitol. While billionaires and their allies continue waging war on working people—with support from corrupt politicians, corporate polluters, ICE, and law enforcement—we’re rising up to demand justice, dignity, and power for all of us.

We fight for public schools over private profits, healthcare over hedge funds, and shared prosperity over corporate politics.

We won’t back down.
We won’t be divided.
We will never stop fighting for our families, our freedoms, and a better future.

On Labor Day, we will join together.

This Labor Day, we continue the movement—standing in solidarity with every community under attack and pushing for real, lasting change.
________________________________________

🌟 After the protest, keep the momentum going!

🗣️ Join us from 11:30 AM to 1:00 PM at the American Legion Hall at Lake Ella for a panel discussion:
“From Florida to the Nation: How State Legislation Became a National Blueprint.”

We’ll explore how recent laws passed in Florida are shaping policy across the country—and what we can do about it. Panelists to be announced soon.

💛 In the spirit of solidarity, the Big Bend Labor Chapter and its affiliated unions will also be raising funds at the event—and via GoFundMe—for Capital City Youth Services, a local nonprofit supporting youth and families in crisis. (GoFundMe link coming soon.)
________________________________________

🕊️ Please note: This is a peaceful, nonviolent protest.
We ask all participants to help de-escalate conflict. Do not bring weapons of any kind—including those otherwise legally permitted.
________________________________________

📢 Let’s build the future we all deserve—together.
Bring your fellow workers, union family, neighbors, and friends.
Tallahassee will rise with labor.

title: Honk For A Change
description:
Hey friends,

We’re turning up the volume every Tuesday in Baton Rouge — and we need YOU out there with us.

The Tuesday Rush Hour Honkers are hitting the streets to Honk for Change — a weekly pop-up protest to make some noise, hold signs, and remind the city that we’re still here, still fighting, and still watching.

 Where: Perkins Road & Kenilworth Parkway
 Parking: BREC Perkins Road Park (easy access!)
 When: Every Tuesday, 4:00 – 5:30 PM
 Yes, there’s shade along the protest line!

Bring a sign. Bring a chair. Bring a friend.
Whether you can stay the whole time or just stop by for a few minutes, your presence matters. Let’s turn as many voices into the many reasons we keep fighting for justice, equity, and accountability.

Let’s be loud. Let’s be seen. Let’s remind Baton Rouge that people power doesn’t clock out at 5.

description:

Time: 9am - 10am
Where: sidewalk at the local Social Security Administration in Palm Springs, 4201 E. Ramon Road

This event will highlight cuts and threatened cuts to social Security as we celebrate its 90th anniversary. Social Security has been a vital source of income for seniors and vulnerable citizens. It's time to hold Congressman Ken Calvert and Republicans accountable, and demand they PROTECT OUR CHECKS!

WE SAY ....HANDS OFF SOCIAL SECURITY!

title: Protect Our Checks Rally in Racine, Wisconsin
description:
Join us for a press conference to protect Social Security as we approach the 90th anniversary of the Social Security Act on August 14th, 2025. Community members, advocates, and local leaders will gather to share their stories about how Social Security serves as a vital lifeline for seniors, people with disabilities, veterans, and working families across our region.

We're calling on Congress to keep Social Security Administration offices open and fully funded instead of prioritizing tax breaks for billionaires while making essential services inaccessible to those who need them most. This event will highlight the real impact that proposed cuts and office closures would have on thousands of people in our community who depend on these benefits to provide for themselves and their families.

Everyone is welcome to attend this important gathering where we'll demonstrate that everyone on Social Security is someone we know and care about - it's time for our elected officials to Protect Our Checks.

title: Motorcade against Fox News driving around Tempe
description:
Tempe Rising is offering a 17" x 12" US American Car Flag Window Clip to all who RSVP and meet us at Brick Road Coffee for the motorcade, limited to one per vehicle.

Sign suggestions.  Reminder, this is an Anti-Fox Motorcard.  Please stick with the theme.   Here are sign suggestions.  

https://www.foxtakedown.com/signs

USE POSTERBOARD!!   Good thing for wind resistance at 45 mph.

Fox [NOT] News made the GOP’S Trump/Musk coup possible! For almost 40 years, Rupert Murdoch’s rightwing propaganda network has lied to the American people, brainwashing millions and setting the stage for a GOP billionaire coup. Now, Fox is TRUMP STATE TV – full stop.

Join us and push back against the most destructive immigrants to ever hit our shores – Rupert Murdoch and Elon Musk!





Our next stop is Brick Road Coffee for a quick restroom break, and it's also our meeting spot for other protesters to join us! Please ensure your car is decorated and ready to go by 8:30 AM. If you'd like to ride with someone else and share the journey, just let us know.

We'll be leaving Brick Road Coffee at 8:30 AM to kick off our motorcade! For those not joining the bridge protest beforehand, no worries at all – just meet us at the Brick Road Coffee parking lot, ready for an exciting start! Please don't forget to grab a coffee from Brick Road.

While you're at Brick Road, you'll also receive your map for the motorcade and a QR code for our Signal chat, so we can all stay connected on the go. Plus, as a special perk, if you're wearing your Tempe Rising T-shirt, you'll get 20% off all food and beverages at Brick Road Coffee!

Fox Take Down. One Message, Infinite Creativity.
The theme for this demonstration is “Fox Take Down.” A readable consistent message of Anti-Fox (Not) News throughout the caravan is important, and we look forward to those fabulously creative homemade signs! A simple message and clear large writing is key for readability if you are standing on a sidewalk by traffic or in a car that is moving.
Here are some sign suggestions.  Signs and Flyers | Fox Takedown
Car Decoration Tips
WINDOW and SIDE PANEL PAINTING
Materials to Use
•	Chalk Paint MARKERS - These are chalk base and advertised prominently “for use on glass”. These are washable and safely used on glass, and most likely safe for short amounts of time on car paint.  Tempe Rising will have Chalk Paint at Brick Road Coffee.
•	Glitter MARKERS - This type of marker can be applied and razored off glass. Please double-check to ensure that any materials you buy are safe for use on your vehicle.
Materials to Avoid
•	Chalk Paint - This is paint used on furniture to mimic old timey milk paint. Make sure you are using the markers!
Markers vary in price. Hobby Lobby & Walmart are the cheapest, with approximately 4 for selling for $6. These are also sold at auto stores for a higher price, and there are lots of options available online.
SIDE DECORATIONS
Materials to Use
•	Poster Board - Thin poster board on the side of vehicle is the best option for signage, as it will mold to the side of the car when taped securely and minimize gaps between sign and surface. Wind will peel signs off, so please burnish down the edges.
•	BLUE Painter’s Tape - For taping down signage, the type of tape used is important. Traditional tan masking tape can leave a residue in the Arizona sun! We have been told painters tape - the blue stuff - doesn’t have this problem. We are using extra wide 2” rolls, to make sure gaps between paper edges and car sides are secure.
Tempe Rising will have rolls of 2” blue painters tape at Brick Road Coffee.
•	Large Magnetized Signs - You can order large magnetized signs from the Gloo Factory (238 E 26th St.), similar to what you see on the sides of their own business trucks. They are roughly $45 a pair, with a 1-week lead time. You can contact the Gloo Factory at info@Thegloofactory.com.
Materials to Avoid
•	Duct Tape, Packing Tape, or Tan Painter’s Tape - These will damage your vehicle!
•	Regular Magnets - These are likely to leave gaps for the wind to catch, dragging the magnet.
•	Cardboard or Thicker Poster/Foam Board - These are best avoided due to their extra thickness and poor moldability, making it easy for wind to peel off.
STREAMERS
The 1/4 inch wide mylar 40x80 inch doorway curtains can be a decoration, with modification - making them shorter so they won’t tangle in your wheels.
These can be shortened by laying them on the floor and giving them a ‘haircut’, salvaging the ‘waste’ by placing duct tape across the width, then cutting across, to make a second ‘header’.
To make the original header more secure when decorating your vehicle, you can reinforce it with duct tape. That husky tape will be a more sturdy header to tape to the car or roll up/trap in a window. There are many options at Dollar Stores, Family Tree, Michaels, etc - plain colors plus Fourth of July red white and blue.
Crepe paper streamers are also an option.
FLAGS
There are lots of opinions about the American flag. Some fly it upright, some fly it upside-down, and some avoid it altogether. During our caravan our politics will be clear: It’s your decision.
Flags can be flown from windows on ‘car flag stands’ - reasonably priced little flag poles caught in window tracks, held up when the window is rolled up. These are reasonably priced, available at Walmart and online.
For BIG flags on a pick up, things are more difficult. You need to have side rail capability to slip a pole into. If you don’t have side rail mounts, you can screw 2 U-shaped pipe brackets into the side walls of the bed to hold a pole. Please note that there will be big wind resistance.
Tempe Rising is offering a 17" x 12" US American Car Flag Window Clip to all who RSVP and meet us at Brick Road Coffee for the motorcade, limited to one per vehicle.
CAR-TOP OBJECTS
This is a People’s Parade, so ambitious rooftop structures and sculptures are welcome! However, note that anything fragile will be ripped off at speeds of 20 to 40 mph, so be sure to test drive this option beforehand!
For securing structures, roof racks are helpful. Another option is to thread a rope through or around the object, then through the back passenger windows, tying a knot inside the car. Bungee cords are also useful. Get creative!

title: The Power of Perspective: Make Your Voice Heard! A Protest Art Show
description:
# ***Make Your Voice Heard! A Protest Art Show***

## **Friday, August 15 · 6PM–9PM  Reception**
## **Saturday, August 16 · 12PM–6PM  Open House**


###### **Eliza's House Omni Creative Center**
###### **35 N Potomac St Hagerstown, MD 21740**


***Art doesn’t whisper - it demands to be heard.***

## 🎤Friday Night Reception
Step into an electrifying atmosphere of music, poetry, dance, and visual art. 
The gallery pulses with stories that challenge injustice and honor resilience. Meet the artists, connect with changemakers, and feel the energy of resistance through rhythm and movement.

## 🎨 Saturday Open House
A hands-on day of creation and dialogue:
- Gallery exhibit: Featuring bold, provocative works that confront today’s most pressing issues
- Community art: Collaborate, contribute, and co-create
- Screening of “Union”: A powerful film about solidarity and struggle
- Button making station: Make your own wearable message

## The Power of Perspective: An Art Exhibition Series

The Power of Perspective is a compelling three-part series that explores the diverse narratives and transformative potential of art to inspire, educate, and evoke change. Each installment shines a spotlight on vital social themes, offering viewers an immersive experience that challenges perceptions and celebrates resilience.

## Part 1: The Juneteenth Experience - June 14th 6PM-9PM

This segment honors the history, legacy, and ongoing journey of emancipation. Through powerful visual storytelling, it commemorates Juneteenth's significance in the fight for freedom and equality, highlighting the resilience and triumph of Black communities.

## Part 2: Make Your Voice Heard - August 15th 6PM-9PM & 16th 12PM-6PM

In this installment, art becomes a tool for advocacy and social justice. Artists use their creative voices to address pressing issues, promote awareness, and inspire action. This section underscores the role of art as a catalyst for societal change and empowerment.

## Part 3: Humans of Hagerstown - October 10th 6PM-9PM

Celebrating the diverse stories of Hagerstown's residents, this final chapter brings local narratives to the forefront. Through portraits and personal stories, it fosters community connection, empathy, and understanding, emphasizing the universal human experience.

Together, The Power of Perspective series invites viewers to see the world through different lenses, emphasizing the transformative power of perspective and the enduring strength of community and hope.

- Snack
- Sunscreen
- Hat and/or sunglasses

There is ample parking on the side streets south of Spicewood Springs Rd, beginning with Parliament Place.

Unity and discipline are hallmark principles of successful nonviolent resistance movements and our movement will remain inviting and blameless if we maintain these principles in the face of provocation.

description:
We embrace COMPASSION, NOT CRUELTY. Bring your signs, bells, streamers, and good spirits and line the sidewalk in front of the Lincoln City Cultural Center - and beyond - on Saturday Aug. 30th, noon - 2 p.m.

As Martin Luther King reminded us, “The arc of the moral universe is long, but it bends toward justice.”  What we do – or don’t do - influences that arc. 

Take a stand for compassion. Expose Trump's cruelty. MAGA forces are exerting tremendous force against the vulnerable. Families are being torn apart, citizens are being abducted, placed in concentration camps - disappeared. Because of the Big Ugly Bill, children will go hungry and families will lose healthcare. Those in recovery, without shelter, or living with disability will lose lifesaving services.

Like No Kings Day, the South Plaza will be used for respite and sign-making materials, postcard writing, and education. There will be snacks & water. Since we will be rallying against cruelty, we will also do something to protect the vulnerable. We will be collecting donations for Community Services Consortium in Lincoln County. You can read about their good work here: https://communityservices.us/about/

The level of cruelty in Trump’s administration is unprecedented. The power of white nationalism within our federal government is unprecedented. Cruelty leads to fear. Fear keeps people from resisting. if we keep our focus on the massive suffering caused by this administration, we will find the strength to resist. 

Our Lincoln City neighbors need to know they are not alone in their desire for a return to compassion. Our presence can hearten them. Our presence can show visitors that this city is not run by MAGA. We can help others feel strong enough to take action, whether by talking to each other, educating themselves about issues, writing postcards to congress, making phone calls, attending city council meetings, helping others to register to vote, running for office, or by VOTING. 

If we show that fear of bullies cannot hold us hostage, then our neighbors will see that they can also Stand Against Cruelty.

Rev. Barber has prayed against the Republican-passed "Big Beautiful Bill Act" while in the Rotunda of our US Capitol because it hurts poor people to benefit rich people. He has noted: “Forty-three percent of women and almost half of all children are poor and low income. Somebody ought to say something … Somebody gotta challenge this budget.”

We oppose the Republican-adopted federal budget resolutions that harm the poorest and most vulnerable of Americans in order to give trillions in tax breaks to the richest and most privileged of Americans.

We oppose cuts to health research, education, housing assistance, community development, child care, and other federal programs for needy veterans, the elderly, and children.

title: Protect Our Checks Rally in Solvang
description:
Social Security isn't just a policy - it's a promise made 90 years ago to create financial security for working people. Now, on the 90th anniversary of the Social Security Act, that promise is under attack.

The threats are real: Republicans in Congress are pushing an agenda that guts programs working families rely on, all to pay for tax breaks for billionaires. 

Over 73 million Americans who rely on Social Security - retirees, people with disabilities, and working families - are being put at risk.

We refuse to stay silent. While billionaires get handouts, working people who've paid into the system their entire lives face benefit cuts and inaccessible services. 

Reports suggest the trust fund could run dry by 2034, leading to 15-20% benefit reductions, not because the system is broken, but because corporations and the ultra-wealthy aren't paying their fair share.
Social Security is a hard-earned lifeline, not a handout. It helps pay rent, buy groceries, and put kids through school. It's a right that millions have earned through decades of work.

Join us as communities nationwide demand Congress protect what we've worked for - protect our checks, protect our future. When FDR signed Social Security in 1935, he called it "a cornerstone in a structure being built." We're here to defend that cornerstone.

The time to act is now. We won't back down.

The Town Hall will feature leaders from many of the upcoming races in Georgia: within Savannah and surrounding counties, plus Congressional District 1, and the Governorship.

This is NOT a campaign rally. No slogans, no soundbites, no speeches. Instead, we’ll come together for in-person discourse about the issues that matter to us, the voting public.

- The festival is free, but food and drinks will be for sale

title: Protect Our Checks Rally at Bridgewater, NJ SSA Office
description:
Trump and the Republicans in Congress jeopardized the Social Security system by cutting staff and increasing budget deficits. They are taking health insurance and nutrition assistance away from millions of Americans, and making it more difficult to access because less staff leads to longer wait times.

Representative Tom Kean has voted for these changes which will harm many of us in CD7. Demand that Kean and the rest  of congress restore funding and the administration improves Social Security’s customer service.

Protect Our Checks: A Day of Action to Defend Social Security As we approach the 90th anniversary of the Social Security Act, we’re coming together to protect the program that millions of Americans rely on. Across the country, Social Security offices are facing staffing cuts, funding freezes, and service disruptions — making it harder for people to access the benefits they’ve earned. Meanwhile, House Republicans continue to prioritize tax breaks for billionaires over everyday people.

Join us for Protect Our Checks, a grassroots day of action demanding that Congress keep Social Security strong and accessible. We’ll uplift the stories of those who depend on it, call out those putting it at risk, and make it clear: Social Security is not negotiable. Bring your signs and bring your voices.

It’s time to choose people over profit.

title: New York, NY: Rally to Urge Council Member Abreu to Defend Local Law 97

location.venue: Shaun Abreu's NYC Council District Office

description:
Join us to deliver hundreds of petition signatures to City Council Member Shaun Abreu's office, urging protection of our landmark climate law for buildings, Local Law 97!

We need Abreu to co-sponsor Intro 1180 to close the "landlord loophole" that enables landlords to buy their way out of making energy upgrades like replacing old boilers with heat pumps. We currently have 18 co-sponsors, and Abreu would be a very welcome addition.

This is one of the most important climate laws in the nation, and it's a climate model for all major cities around the world. We've all seen the climate change-fueled flash floods and wildfires happening, so we can't keep kicking the can down the road for future generations to deal with it. The time to act is now!
